title: Why Do Mainframes Still Exist?  What's Inside One?  40TB, 200+ Cores, AI, and more!
summary: Dave Plummer tours the IBM z16 mainframe from design through factory assembly, test lab, accelerators and water cooling. He explains why mainframes still exist and what makes them reliable.
why: Recommended as an accessible tour of modern mainframes that compares them sensibly to ordinary server setups.

quote.text: This is an amazing 23-minute video by the Microsoft programmer who developed the Windows NT Task Manager, among other things.
